instructions: OpentronsAgent 0.2.0 reads Opentrons shared data (labware, pipette, deck and module definitions) from the Opentrons repository on GitHub: target shared_data for raw JSON files, target github for directory listings (query ref=edge or a release tag). It does not talk to a robot: the robot HTTP API is plain http on your network, which this extension does not use.

targets.name: shared_data
targets.title: Opentrons shared data on GitHub (raw files)

targets.name: github
targets.title: GitHub contents API for the Opentrons repository (listings)
